name: pollarbase-monorepo
description: Pollarbase - The Data Schlep Handler. We handle the schlep so you don't have to

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend,admin -c magenta,cyan,green "pnpm --filter @pollarbase/web dev" "cd packages/backend && pip install --quiet aiomysql && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 --host 0.0.0.0" "pnpm --filter @pollarbase/admin dev -p 3002"

author: Pollarbase Team
